reference: Pressure-test structure aligned with the root PDF template.

test_stack: H2 in-memory database (MODE=MySQL) or real MySQL, depending on DbMode

scenarios.name: concurrent-account-opening
scenarios.description: Concurrent security-account and fund-account opening chain.
scenarios.sample_type: 30 unique adult personal investors with distinct ID numbers
success_criteria: Each generated investor ID can be mapped to a non-closed security account
No task returns an exception or business error

scenarios.name: duplicate-fund-callback
scenarios.sample_type: 120 repeated callbacks with the same ref_order_id
success_criteria: Only one effective fund transaction log is persisted for the ref_order_id

scenarios.name: duplicate-holding-callback
scenarios.sample_type: 120 repeated callbacks with the same ref_order_id and stock_code
success_criteria: Only one effective holding-change log is persisted for the ref_order_id

scenarios.name: concurrent-query-mix
scenarios.description: Mixed concurrent reads across dashboard, list, and log endpoints.
scenarios.sample_type: 400 read requests distributed across 5 internal query endpoints
success_criteria: High request success rate under the configured concurrency
No system-level DAO or connection-establishment failures
Verification queries can complete after scenario execution
